steps.domain_action: The vacuum state initializes the field potential.
The field identifies its own baseline symmetry.
A positive winding operation initiates the topological charge.
The winding operation is composed with the existing field geometry.
The system bifurcates into primary and secondary winding paths.
The primary path achieves stable integer winding.
The charge propagates forward through the lattice.
The secondary path recombines to stabilize the global invariant.
The stabilized charge is linked to the next iteration of the cycle.
The current winding state is fixed into the geometric record.
A recursive check splits the state to verify parity.
The negative parity branch is evaluated for potential decay.
A reverse winding operation compensates for parity drift.
The parity correction fuses with the main charge.
The corrected topological invariant is permanently recorded.
The boundary closes to preserve the total winding number.
